title: Adaptive robots will need competent, goal-seeking parts

statements.text: Adaptive, useful robotics will require components that are themselves competent and goal-seeking, at the price that such parts can occasionally defect, as cancer cells do.
statements.falsification_criteria: Highly adaptive robots built from parts with no local goals.

prediction.resolution_criterion: Highly adaptive robotic systems are achieved only with components that pursue local goals, and none are achieved with uniformly passive parts.

sources.quote: It is a prediction of this view that adaptive, useful robotics will require components that are themselves competent and goal-seeking.
